name: Sarulf
description: The divine being who sends wolf children to his chosen.

timeline.summary: In the Aldergard, Asi and an Omenseeker discuss whether the culprit is the Cosmos Monster Sarulf.
timeline.quote: He is one of the Cosmos Monsters.

timeline.summary: Lathril wakes to find a copper wolf in her bed, evidently sent by Sarulf.
timeline.quote: she found herself face-to-face with a pair of turquoise eyes, set in the face of a beautiful copper wolf

relations.note: Lathril assumes the wolf is one of Sarulf's wolf children sent to his chosen.
relations.quote: There was only one divine being that sent wolf children to his chosen, and that was Sarulf.

pages_say.description: A Cosmos Monster, a wolf said to eat realms, feared by an Omenseeker as the culprit.
The divine being who sends wolf children to his chosen.
